source_annotation.prompt: Pick up the cup from the table and place it in the container

generation_prompt: The robot uses the hand entering from the lower-right edge to wrap its fingers and thumb around the blue mug's body, lifts it off the checkered tablecloth, and carries it over to the pink bowl. It lowers the mug upright into the bowl, opens its hand to release it, then withdraws upward and to the right, leaving the mug resting inside the bowl. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
